cohort.histories: per role across 3 DEV seeds within each family, independent at family/role reset; episode-local occupied and last-drop cooldown reset at world reset; no hidden carried inventory/pose/map
cohort.seed_disjoint: new 1021xxx cohort must not occur in any known reachable parent source or previous selected DEV; validation checks 12 distinct identities and parent grep

mechanism.goal: Distinguish public-precondition-valid drop execution from useful exploration; falsify whether preventing immediate reuse of recently dropped incidental objects restores target encounters and genuine goals.
mechanism.policy: Exact unchanged MG40 evidence-memory score, own selected-action empirical state, original public-only effect-detected occupied proxy. After a genuine own-selected publicly confirmed drop, set 16-step cooldown. During cooldown, only when original source policy selects pickup action3 while publicly pickupable object faces front, override that own selected choice to a turn 0 or 1 deterministically based only on internal original selected turn counts and recent turn chain. Otherwise use unchanged choice. No mission-target or route-specific condition. The action semantics, public object detector and cooldown are engineered not autonomously discovered.
mechanism.cooldown_decrement: decrement by one after each own selected feedback, then set to 16 after publicly successful selected drop; no counterfactual observations
mechanism.turn_selection: choose left if empirical global selected left count <= right count, else right; when blocked original candidate already rotated this step, leave intact
mechanism.original_evidence_policy: mg40 EvidenceNavigation exact class, score intact except veto after original choose returns, no new reward shaping
mechanism.allowed_override: only original choice3 when cooldown>0 and public front class in(5,6,7); replace to min-count turn0/1 and update pending selected action tuple consistently
mechanism.ablation: exact original MG40 evidence enabled and disabled arms remain unchanged, plus old MG38 and MG39B, strong unchanged public/native controls
mechanism.checkpoint: canonical source-selected checkpoint includes cooldown and source-selected count, cold byte exact; cooldown persisted within episode and reset across original env.reset; never copy private state
mechanism.non_claim: A benefit would be from an engineered non-repetition guard with publicly observed selected feedback, NOT learned action semantics, genuine causal discovery, independent native learning or generalization.

metrics.original: actual positive terminal goal episodes, exact mission target front exposure, publicly confirmed mission target pickup effects, public target anywhere visibility, selected pickup/drop attempts and successful observed effects
metrics.alternation: after selected effect original pickup then selected drop then pickup short chains <=16, own public before/after hashes; no claim same physical object/position
metrics.selection: per action histogram, forward versus turns, unique egocentric contexts without physical mapping, source selected action steps
metrics.source: complete authenticated event hashes and both independent original process canonical SHA identical
metrics.resources: matched original action cap but Go child CPU/RSS/energy parity remains UNQUALIFIED. No efficiency or scientific transfer claim

primary_all: candidate fewer verified short reversible public effect pairs (pickup then drop within 4 selected actions) than unchanged MG40 enabled on matched original DEV
candidate at least one exact target pickup effect in unfamiliar pickup families
candidate at least one positive original terminal goal in UnlockPickup or BlockedUnlockPickup
candidate genuine positive terminal goals in at least 2 distinct unfamiliar pickup families
candidate positive unfamiliar goal episode count strictly exceeds each unchanged MG40 enabled/disabled and MG38 and MG39B counterparts
canonical source matches across two full independent original runs and exact 144 original episodes
frozen_dev_acceptance.secondary: Engineering reduction in reversal counts alone cannot rescue the frozen development criterion

next: If DEV still fails retain negative and evaluate whether action-effect policies have to identify decision value via own selected histories without engineered target scripts. Any successful DEV requires independently sourced held-out transfer, matched conventional controls and full native resource parity before native integration.
